body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally within 5 units would gain a normal Condition.

body.label: Effect
body.html: You may take that Condition instead; if you do, the ally becomes Rallied.

surges.html: You or one ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
If the triggering effect is supernatural, suppress one Rank 0 maintained benefit until the end of the turn.
